title: The Asian Threads of the American Tapestry【PZRT2022-S4】
description:
Join the People’s Zoom Readers Theater as we appreciate the history of Asian Threads in the American Tapestry and reject expressions of  anti Asian hate!!!

Join us (email to: readerstheater2014@gmail.com) in February for our performance & discussion event "We are The Village" … all people responsible for the health and welfare of our children!
